# ComboBox intrinsic-width component spec races narrow field DOM mount

## Context

`test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs:379` (`"Un-sized ComboBox and Country fields keep intrinsic input width in align-start containers and shrink when constrained"`, added in `#21537` for `#21512`) failed twice within an hour in `Engine Tests / components (2/3)` on PRs touching zero form-field code:
- Run `44852304722` on `#21687` (`examples/scheduler/timeZones`)
- Run `44857054634` / job `136704880644` on `#21724` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs`)

Both runs threw `page.evaluate: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'getBoundingClientRect')`. Curated `good first issue` / `help wanted` labels are omitted because this is an active CI shard-2/3 blocker owned immediately by the spec's author.

## The Problem

Under 2-vCPU CI shard contention (`components (2/3)`), the test's `measureField(id)` helper executes on the Main Thread while the sixth `createNeoInstance` child (`narrow`, `ids.narrowId`) has not yet had its VDOM `insertNode` delta applied to `document`, causing `document.getElementById(id)` to return `null` and throwing on `el.getBoundingClientRect()`. Locally on multi-core developer machines the second VDOM batch lands before Playwright's `page.evaluate` round-trip, masking the race (`3/3` green on `dev` `42272b8b5f`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.worker.App#createNeoInstance` (`src/worker/App.mjs:180-216`) calls `parent.add(config)` synchronously inside the App Worker and returns `{success: true, id: instance.id}` before the VDOM Worker and Main Thread commit the resulting DOM deltas.
- `ComboBox.spec.mjs:380-439` invokes `await Neo.worker.App.createNeoInstance(...)` six times sequentially across `await import(...)` boundaries (`container`, `text`, `combo`, `inlineCombo`, `country`, `narrow`). When `container` flushes an initial VDOM update batch containing `text` through `country` (`Country.mjs:34-47` uses synchronous `CountryFlags.countries` data), `narrow` (`:422-430`) queues into a follow-up `updateVdom` cycle while `container.isUpdating` is true.
- Line `444` only awaits `page.locator('#${ids.countryId} input.neo-textfield-input:not(.neo-typeahead-input)').toHaveValue('germany')` (from batch 1) and never awaits `ids.narrowId` (batch 2) or the other three fields before `measureField` (`:447-453`) calls `.getBoundingClientRect()` on all five field IDs.
- Design authority: `.agents/skills/whitebox-e2e/references/whitebox-e2e-protocol.md` §3 ("Wait for what the test acts on ... Wait on the plugin's own DOM node or listener, never a sleep").

## The Fix

In `test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs` (`:444-446`), before `page.evaluate` runs `measureField`, await Playwright DOM readiness on every measured field (`textId`, `comboId`, `inlineComboId`, `countryId`, `narrowId`) — specifically `toBeVisible()` on each `#${id} .neo-input-wrapper`, `.neo-field-trigger` on the trigger-bearing fields, and `toHaveValue('California')` on `narrowId` alongside `toHaveValue('germany')` on `countryId`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every field measured by `measureField` (`textId`, `comboId`, `inlineComboId`, `countryId`, `narrowId`) has its `.neo-input-wrapper` (and `.neo-field-trigger` where applicable) awaited via Playwright `expect(...).toBeVisible()` plus value readiness on `countryId` and `narrowId` before `page.evaluate` reads `.getBoundingClientRect()`.
- [ ] `npx playwright test test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs --repeat-each 5` passes `5/5` per test locally with zero `getBoundingClientRect` null dereferences.

## Out of Scope

Changing `Neo.worker.App#createNeoInstance`'s return contract across all component specs; modifying `Neo.form.field.ComboBox` or `Neo.form.field.Country` runtime source.

## Avoided Traps

- **Adding `page.waitForTimeout(...)`:** Sleeps are brittle under CI load and violate `whitebox-e2e-protocol.md` §3; waiting on each measured field's actual DOM wrapper/input deterministically proves Main Thread mount completion.
